items.headline: Givance returns fumble 24 yards for TD, North Dakota State beats Sacramento State 31-10
items.description: — Nathan Hayes threw a 33-yard touchdown pass to Jackson Williams and Darius Givance returned a fumble 24 yards for a score in the opening minutes to help North Dakota State beat Sacramento State 31-10 on Saturday night.

items.headline: Mandal helps Fresno State unload on Sacramento State in 49-3 win
items.description: — Jayden Mandal threw for two touchdowns and Bryson Donelson ran for three scores and Fresno State scored 32-second quarter points en route to a 49-3 win over Sacramento State on Saturday night.
